from math import *
def pi_wallis(x):
    pa=1
    i=0
    while True:
        i=i+1
        pp=pa
        pa=pa*(2*i/(2*i-1))*(2*i/(2*i+1))
        if (abs(2*pa-2*pp)<=x):
            break
    return pa*2
print("La valeur approché de PI WALLIS à 10^-4 prés est: ",pi_wallis(0.0001))
